goals.goal: Personal data transmitted across the company's network paths, inter-service channels, and third-party API connections remains confidential and unaltered in transit, with the level of protection proportionate to the risk of the five Art. 32(2) event classes (accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure of, or access to, personal data transmitted).
goals.adjustment: Scope narrowed from all data in transit to personal data (Art. 4(1)); protection level anchored to GDPR's risk-based "appropriate" standard with the five-event risk enumeration as the assessment frame; applies to an 8-person controller/processor operating managed-cloud channels.

goals.goal: Data transmitted by the product with digital elements is rendered unintelligible to any person not authorised to access it via state-of-the-art encryption in transit, and the product's exposed interfaces through which such data could leak are minimised.
goals.source: Annex I Part I (2)(e); Annex I Part I (2)(j)
goals.adjustment: Threshold raised from GDPR's risk-anchored "appropriate" to CRA's "state-of-the-art" (harmonised-standards-conformant); attack-surface-limitation leg (2)(j) added as a distinct manufacturer obligation; scope is product-level (all data the product transmits, not only personal data); applies to a default-class manufacturer with self-assessment conformity.
